title: 01/15/21 - Software Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: 01/15/21 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000076991 We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website. We fixed an issue which was causing the Insta-Load Search Results Add-On to load inaccurate search results in some cases. We updated the "Posted by Snippet" widget on post details pages to support special characters in post category URLs. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Posted By Snippet We fixed an issue which was preventing members from being able to delete posts from the Member Dashboard when there are 30,000+ posts of the same type saved on the site. The Dynamic Category Filter Add-On is now compatible with the "Module Font Color" Design Setting. We fixed minor UI issues with the Batch Geocoder Tool in the Admin. We updated the "Permalink Structure" data shown in the Web Page Builder in the Admin to display the page's URL instead of the post type name when the Page Type of a page is set as "Post Search Results". We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from saving the "Overlay Color" Hero Section setting when creating/editing a page in the Web Page Builder in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the "%%Data_Name%%" variable from resolving correctly on Post Search Results pages. We deprecated the "Bootstrap Theme - Module - Sidebar Navigation Links" widget. The Chat Message datatable in the Member Dashboard area is now fully compatible with Text Labels. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to search by keyword on the Coupons Code page in the Admin. The "Verify Member Icon" on the "Verify Your Identity" page in the Member Dashboard area will now always use the "Verify Member Icon" image set on the Brand Images section of the General Settings page in the Admin. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Verify Listing We updated the logic of the Blog and Articles with Sidebar streaming widgets in order to display full-width when no sidebar is selected. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Articles with Sidebar Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Blog Articles with Sidebar We fixed an issue which was preventing the Multi-Location Listing Add-On from displaying the number of locations a member has been listed in on the Service Areas page in the Member Dashboard when one of the locations contained a dash in its name. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Select Locations We created separate Text Labels for all text related to the Newsletter Signup forms and modules used on the front-end of sites. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Button - Newsletter Subscribe Text labels Involved: newsletter_subscribe_footer_text newsletter_subscribe_modal_title newsletter_subscribe_module_title We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from respecting the search results title font size in some cases. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Custom Appearance Settings Bootstrap Theme - Single Post Page The Facebook Website Chat Add-On is now compatible with the Default Website Language setting. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme Framework The "Public Main Menu" and "Members Main Menu" Design Settings will now only allow selecting menus which include the words "Main Menu" in the name of the Menu. We updated the Stripe Payment Gateway logic in order to support international payments when the site is located in India. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to import members via CSV file in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the member login logic from working properly when there is no Recaptcha credentials on the site in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Google ReCaptcha on Sign up Page We fixed an issue which was preventing the Homepage Product Search widget from returning accurate data from the categories and price slider fields in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Products Search We created a new Design Setting called "Button Corners Style" to easily change the design of the buttons of the site. To use this new feature navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> General tab >> Default Button Links Color section. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Custom Appearance Settings We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from loading the Post forms when creating/editing a post in the Member Dashboard area when the Post filename includes a number as part of the URL. We fixed an issue which was preventing Admins from sending an email using the "Send Email Notification" feature from the Transaction History page if the email address contained a special character in some cases. We fixed a design issue which was causing the One-Click Social Login buttons to look misaligned when when using the Add-On on pages other than the login page in some cases. We implemented a set of design updates to the Member Content tab on the Member Account Details page in the Admin. We added pagination to the Membership Plans page in the Admin to speed up the loading of the page for sites that have dozens of Membership Plans. The "Please enter the same value" validation error text on signup forms is now compatible with Text Labels. We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Max. Sub-Level Categories Member Can Select" Membership Plan setting from working properly when the "All" value has been set in some cases. Widget Involved: Search - Member - Search Query We fixed an issue which was causing Header Main Menu dropdown items to hide behind the Homepage Hero image when using the Safari web browser in some cases. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
